title: Build provider quality and cost evaluation harness
description: Create a deterministic provider-role evaluation surface plus explicit credential-gated live cases. Compare evidence quality, freshness, hard filters, social coverage, excerpts/context, latency, token/request cost, rate-limit metadata, and failure behavior. Benchmark shipped providers by capability instead of ranking vendors globally; no default fan-out.

logs.msg: Added scripts/provider-eval.ts and deterministic tests. The evaluator measures inspectable evidence, provenance, hard constraints, excerpt/date/social coverage, usage, latency, and explicit case requirements without ranking relevance or issuing network fan-out. Added docs/provider-evaluation.md; existing credential-gated live-smoke remains the one-provider observation source. Tests and typecheck pass.
